running_thesis: Nvidia and the AI trade drive the Nasdaq-100. On 25 Nov it touched bear territory intraday and closed at 26046.9 (-0.64%) as dip buyers stepped in. S&P put Nvidia debt on CreditWatch negative and Moody's cut the outlook. Core PCE is 3.26% y/y, the 10-year 4.85%. VXN 38.53, VIX 28.29, COR1M 25.45 on 25 Nov. A December hike is priced at 94.5% (Polymarket), January 59% on CME. US was closed on 26 Nov and 27 Nov is a thin half-day. Rebound headlines are unverified. JOLTS 1 Dec, jobs 4 Dec, FOMC 9 Dec.
open_questions: Do dip buyers hold through the thin half-day and on Monday?
Do Nvidia credit and governance issues escalate before the early-December hearings?
Is the tariff concern confirmed with detail?
Do JOLTS and jobs data move the 9 Dec hike path?
